import math

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    eps = 1e-9

    degrees = [graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    clusts = [graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    cores = [graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    betws = [graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    eigs = [graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes]

    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    avg_deg = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)
    degree_var = pre.get('degree_variance', 1)
    bridge_ratio_high_bc = pre.get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 1e-3)

    # Normalize helper
    def normalize(vals):
        mn, mx = min(vals), max(vals)
        if mx - mn < eps:
            return [0.5]*len(vals)
        return [(v - mn) / (mx - mn) for v in vals]

    clust_inv = [1 - c for c in clusts]
    clust_inv_n = normalize(clust_inv)
    cores_n = normalize(cores)
    betws_n = normalize(betws)
    eigs_n = normalize(eigs)

    def harmonic_mean(a, b):
        return 2 * a * b / (a + b + eps)

    def sigmoid(x):
        return 1 / (1 + math.exp(-x))

    best_score = -float('inf')
    best_node = None

    for i, n in enumerate(unvisited_nodes):
        hm = harmonic_mean(clust_inv_n[i], cores_n[i])
        diff = betws_n[i] - eigs_n[i]
        sig = sigmoid(diff * 10)  # scale difference for sharper sigmoid
        score = hm * sig

        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = n

    return best_node
